import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
import warnings
import os
import joblib

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

# Create output directory
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

# Feature columns (all except Id and Cover_Type)
feature_cols = [col for col in train.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]

# Split data for validation (hold-out split)
train_val, val = train_test_split(train, test_size=0.15, random_state=42)

# Prepare features and target
X_train = train_val[feature_cols].copy()
X_val = val[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_val["Cover_Type"].values
y_val = val["Cover_Type"].values

# Identify distance-based columns for log transform and ratios
distance_cols = [
    "Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology",
    "Vertical_Distance_To_Hydrology",
    "Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways",
    "Horizontal_Distance_To_Fire_Points",
]

# Apply log transformation (with log+1 to handle zeros)
for col in distance_cols:
    if col in X_train.columns and col in X_val.columns:
        X_train[col] = np.log1p(X_train[col].values)
        X_val[col] = np.log1p(X_val[col].values)


# Create ratio features between distance pairs
def create_ratio_features(df):
    ratios = {}
    # Distance to distance ratios
    distance_pairs = [
        ("Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology", "Vertical_Distance_To_Hydrology"),
        ("Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology", "Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways"),
        ("Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology", "Horizontal_Distance_To_Fire_Points"),
        ("Vertical_Distance_To_Hydrology", "Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways"),
        ("Vertical_Distance_To_Hydrology", "Horizontal_Distance_To_Fire_Points"),
        ("Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways", "Horizontal_Distance_To_Fire_Points"),
    ]
    for name1, name2 in distance_pairs:
        col_name = f"{name1}_ratio_{name2}"
        if name1 in df.columns and name2 in df.columns:
            df[col_name] = df[name1].values / (df[name2].values + 1e-8)
        if name2 in df.columns and name1 in df.columns:
            df[f"{name2}_ratio_{name1}"] = df[name2].values / (df[name1].values + 1e-8)
    return df


X_train = create_ratio_features(X_train)
X_val = create_ratio_features(X_val)

# Train LightGBM classifier with optimized parameters for speed (same as previous best)
lgbm = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    max_depth=8,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    min_child_samples=50,
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbosity=-1,
    random_state=42,
)
lgbm.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Validate on hold-out set
y_pred_val = lgbm.predict(X_val)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_pred_val)
print(f"Hold-out validation accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Prepare test set predictions
X_test = test[feature_cols].copy()

# Apply same log transform and ratio features to test set
for col in distance_cols:
    if col in X_test.columns:
        X_test[col] = np.log1p(X_test[col].values)

X_test = create_ratio_features(X_test)

# Create submission file
y_pred_test = lgbm.predict(X_test)
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test["Id"], "Cover_Type": y_pred_test})
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Prediction value range: {y_pred_test.min()} - {y_pred_test.max()}")
print(f"Final validation accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")
